findings.title: pub(super) does not satisfy pub use re-export; private items must be promoted to pub
evidence: E0364 error: pub use ce_schema::{...} of pub(super) items fails because pub(super) items are not visible at the parent's pub use re-export site.

Fix: promote collect_bundle_chunks, collect_bundle_chunks_legacy, collect_v3_keys_for_bundle, COUNTEREXAMPLE_BUNDLES, COUNTEREXAMPLE_BUNDLE_EVENTS, KNOWN_BUNDLE_SCHEMA_VERSIONS to pub in ce_schema.rs.
This matches the pattern used in m9-84 (ce_chunk_keys.rs) and m9-86 (ce_types.rs): all submodule items are pub, parent re-exports via pub use.

findings.title: cfg(test) allow(unused_imports) used for test-only re-exports of removed code
evidence: counterexample_storage.rs test code uses bundle_prefix, decode_chunk_key, decode_chunk_value directly (m9-04 layout tests).
These items became unused in production after the schema section was moved to ce_schema.rs.
Wrapped the parent's pub(super) use of these 3 items in #[cfg(test)] #[allow(unused_imports)] to silence the warning while preserving test reachability.

findings.title: crate::ce_chunk_keys is not a valid path from sibling submodules
evidence: ce_schema.rs tried use crate::ce_chunk_keys::{...} — fails because ce_chunk_keys is a child of counterexample_storage, not crate root.
